kiri.name: Kiri Haldane
kiri.look: a young woman with long straight black hair and a pale, tired face; travel-worn grey-white tunic and dark leggings, a red scarf, a plain single-edged sword
kiri.horror: hums without knowing it; spirals turn up wherever she sleeps
kiri.weapon: a plain single-edged sword held in the right hand
kiri.tell: the loose end of her scarf always curls into a small spiral
kiri.special: Spiral Cut: a single sweeping slash that traces a spiral in the air (3 frames: draw back, spiral sweep, spiral hanging in the air behind the blade)
kiri.limit: Lullaby for Ostrel: she stands still with her eyes closed and mouth slightly open, humming; faint spiral lines rise off her

twists.sleep: a faint spiral is drawn in the dark beside her head, as if traced by a fingertip while she slept
twists.strained: her lips are parted as if humming; a spiral has started in the corner of one eye's iris
twists.confuse: she is humming with a soft, empty smile, eyes following something circling slowly in front of her

natsu.name: Natsu
natsu.look: a gentle young woman with very long pale blonde hair; a cream and white healer's robe; a spiked halo crown behind her head with small human faces caught in it; hands often pressed together
natsu.horror: every patient she heals leaves a face behind in her halo
natsu.weapon: no weapon; she casts with both hands pressed together
natsu.accent: the dull gold of her halo
natsu.tell: her halo holds three or four tiny pale faces, just a few pixels each, with dark dot eyes
natsu.special: Cure: hands pressed together, then opened outward; the faces in her halo turn toward the target (3 frames)
natsu.limit: Halo of Faces: arms spread, the halo flares wide and every face in it opens its mouth

twists.normal: keep the small faces in the halo; they are calm and their eyes are closed
twists.lowhp: the faces in the halo have opened their eyes and are all looking at her
twists.zombie: one face in the halo is mouthing words at her ear
twists.ko: the faces in the halo are still awake, looking out of the frame

tetsugi.name: Tetsugi Haldane
tetsugi.look: a lean, muscular young man with a close-shaved head; stitched seams across his scalp, neck and chest; a tan martial artist's gi tied with a rope belt; bare wrapped fists
tetsugi.horror: Kiri's brother, revived by Phoenix Down every night; feathers grow under his stitched skin
tetsugi.tell: a single grey feather tip pokes out of a seam at his collar
tetsugi.special: Counter: a guard stance, then a sudden backhand strike (3 frames: guard, twist, strike)
tetsugi.limit: Again and Again: a flurry of punches; his stitches strain and a feather tip pushes out of one seam

twists.lowhp: a seam on his neck has split and a damp feather tip is showing
twists.zombie: his stitches have loosened; small grey feathers lie flat under the skin like a second skin
twists.ko: his eyes are open and calm, as if he has done this many times before
twists.hurt: a stitch pops; the wound underneath is feathered, not bloody

miren.name: Miren
miren.look: a brash young man with messy, spiky pale gold hair; red and dark-iron dragoon armour; a long spear whose shaft has grown into his right forearm, wood fused with veins
miren.horror: his spear has grown into his arm; he refuses to touch the ground
miren.weapon: a long spear fused into the right forearm, the shaft merging into the skin
miren.tell: his heels never touch the ground: in every standing frame he is on tiptoe, and the spear shaft runs into his forearm with no hand gripping it
miren.special: Jump: crouch, leap upward out of frame (only his legs visible at the top of the cell), then plunge down spear-first (3 frames). His feet never quite touch the ground in idle frames: he stands on tiptoe
miren.limit: Falling Star: diving straight down, spear first, trailing pale light

twists.normal: he stands with his heels lifted, never flat on the ground
twists.lowhp: the veins from the spear have crept up past his elbow
twists.strained: he glances down at the ground with open fear
twists.paralyze: the spear-arm has stiffened and is pulling him, the veins dark and rigid

goku.name: Goku
goku.look: a calm young woman with short dark hair under a mossy green-brown hooded cloak; leather wraps; small animal bones on cords; one hand slightly too large and furred
goku.horror: her body is slowly reshaping into the beasts she calls
goku.weapon: a short bone whistle; she fights with a clawed hand
goku.tell: her right hand is visibly too large, furred and clawed
goku.special: Summon Hound: she raises the whistle to her lips; a huge shadowy hound's head rises behind her (3 frames)
goku.limit: The Pack: she drops to all fours, back arched like an animal, with several hound shadows around her

twists.lowhp: fur is spreading up her neck and her pupils have narrowed into an animal's
twists.berserk: her jaw has lengthened slightly and her teeth are a hound's
twists.sleep: she is curled the way a dog sleeps

hisui.name: Hisui
hisui.look: a young woman with long straight black hair and a cold, beautiful face; a long crimson coat; twin curved blades; a large red chrysanthemum-like flower growing at her shoulder
hisui.horror: the Tide-Widow's daughter; her wounds bloom into red flowers with eyes
hisui.weapon: twin curved blades, one in each hand
hisui.tell: the red flower at her shoulder has one dark eye at its centre
hisui.special: Double Cut: two fast crossing slashes, one per blade (3 frames)
hisui.limit: Garden of Eyes: a spinning dance, red petals around her, some petals with eyes

twists.hurt: a red bud opens from the fresh cut
twists.lowhp: her wounds have bloomed into red flowers, and the flowers have eyes
twists.berserk: the flowers on her are all open and staring at the enemy, like she is
twists.ko: the flowers on her body are still blooming

kuro.name: Kuro
kuro.look: a thin young woman with very long, lank dark purple-black hair falling over her face; layered violet and black robes; hollow, shadowed eyes
kuro.horror: hollowed out by her own spells; you can hear wind inside her when she speaks
kuro.weapon: no weapon; she casts with one open hand
kuro.tell: her hair always drifts as if in a wind, even in frames where nothing else moves
kuro.special: Dark: she lifts one hand; a black orb forms in her palm and her hair lifts as if in wind (3 frames)
kuro.limit: Empty House: her mouth opens wide and darkness pours out of it; her body looks paper-thin

twists.lowhp: a crack in her cheek shows that there is nothing inside, only dark
twists.strained: her hair blows in a wind that touches nothing else
twists.zombie: her eyes have gone completely black and empty

ren.name: Ren
ren.look: a weathered man in his late forties with stubble and old scars; a wide-brimmed dark hat; a long dark airship captain's coat with brass buttons; a long-barrelled pistol
ren.horror: captain of the airship; has flown the same circular route for forty years
ren.weapon: a long-barrelled pistol held in the right hand
ren.tell: his pupils sit in a different place in each idle frame, slowly tracing a circle
ren.special: Delay Shot: draw, aim with the arm straight out, fire with a bright muzzle flash (3 frames)
ren.limit: Last Round: fanning the hammer, several muzzle flashes, spent shells in the air

twists.strained: he is checking an old pocket watch; its hands have no numbers to point to
twists.sleep: he sleeps upright, hat tipped down, one hand still on the gun
twists.slow: his face has aged decades; his eyes are tracing a circle

sayo.name: Sayo
sayo.look: a young woman with soft wavy silver-white hair; a pale blue and white choir dress with a high collar; a small tuning fork on a chain
sayo.horror: a choir defector; the other singers' faces still follow her around
sayo.weapon: a tuning fork on a chain; she casts by singing
sayo.tell: one or two faint, pale choir faces float just behind her shoulders in every battle frame
sayo.special: Quick Song: one hand to her chest, mouth open singing, small pale notes curling away from her (3 frames)
sayo.limit: Choir of One: arms raised, singing; faint faces of other singers hover around her, singing with her

twists.normal: two faint faces of choir singers float behind her shoulders, eyes closed
twists.lowhp: the choir faces behind her have moved closer and are singing
twists.confuse: she cannot tell which of the faces around her is her own
twists.ko: the choir faces are singing over her

kugai.name: Kugai
kugai.look: a tall knight in heavy dark armour with blood-red trim; his helmet is open and where the face should be there is smooth black nothing; no ears; a tower shield and a broad sword
kugai.horror: a Varn knight with no face and no ears; he has never heard the note
kugai.weapon: a broad sword in the right hand and a tower shield on the left arm
kugai.tell: inside the open helmet, where his face should be, is flat pure black with no features in every frame
kugai.special: Provoke: he slams the sword against the shield and leans forward (3 frames: raise, strike, brace)
kugai.limit: Hollow Crown: sword raised overhead in both hands; the black where his face should be widens

twists.all: he has no face: every portrait must keep the face area a smooth black void. Show his state through posture, armour damage and what is reflected or gathering in the void, never through a face
twists.berserk: red light is collecting in the void like a pupil
twists.sleep: the void is perfectly still; a thin line of frost crosses it
twists.confuse: the void reflects a second, smaller Kugai looking back

fuyori.name: Fuyori
fuyori.look: a young woman with a neat dark bob haircut and a sharp, studious face; an olive green imperial alchemist's coat with many pockets; patches of pale crystal growing on her cheek and hands; a notebook and glass vials
fuyori.horror: an imperial alchemist sealed in a crystal coffin, still taking notes
fuyori.weapon: glass vials she throws; a notebook in her other hand
fuyori.tell: small pale-blue crystal patches grow on her cheek and the backs of her hands
fuyori.special: Mix: she uncorks a vial, pours it into another, and holds the smoking result up to the light (3 frames)
fuyori.limit: Distillation: she stands inside a ring of rising vapour, crystal spreading up her arm

twists.lowhp: the crystal has spread across half her face
twists.paralyze: she has gone glassy, crystal across both hands, still holding the pen
twists.sleep: she sleeps sitting up, inside a faint outline of a crystal coffin

shio.name: Shio
shio.look: a pale young woman in a grey-blue hood and wrapped robes; open eyes scattered across her skin, her hood lining and her hands
shio.horror: covered in eyes; each one is a future she has already seen
shio.weapon: no weapon; she reads the future with an open palm that has an eye in it
shio.tell: a few small open eyes show on her hands and the lining of her hood
shio.special: Foresee: she opens her palm toward the enemy; every eye on her body turns to look the same way (3 frames)
shio.limit: All Eyes Open: hood thrown back, every eye on her body wide open

twists.normal: most of the eyes on her skin are closed
twists.sleep: her own two eyes are closed but every other eye on her is open
twists.lowhp: the eyes on her are weeping
twists.inspired: every eye on her is open and calm
